## Services

- Printing & printing solutions: printing services, ink and printing materials, printing equipment and instruments.
- Trading, import & export: mobile phones trading, general trading, and electrical and electronic spare parts.
- Ink and printing material: ink, toner, paper rolls and printing materials for business and production needs.
- Electrical and electronics applications spare parts trading: trading and sourcing support for electrical and electronics application spare parts.
- Digital solutions: e-commerce, multimedia development, web design, and digital content services.
